meta.title: PokePrisma · Your next legend
meta.description: Discover PokePrisma: a Pokémon card collection and turn-based battle project.

common.cardNotice: These cards showcase the visual direction. They are not part of an inventory and do not have PokePrisma battle stats yet.

hero.description: The thrill of an unexpected card. The strategy of a team like no other. We're creating a place for both.
hero.hint: Move your cursor over the card
hero.caption: A collection of possibilities.
hero.captionSub: A first look today. Your adventure tomorrow.

universe.title:
Collect the thrill.
Build your story.
universe.intro: Three ways to live one adventure. This is the game we're building.
universe.packsText: Earn coins in battle, open packs and find the card that transforms your collection. Duplicates count too: turn them into fragments.
universe.teamText: Build your team, discover more powerful variants and combine types and support cards to make it your own.
universe.battleText: Learn against the computer, then challenge friends in private rooms. Turns, status effects and decisions that matter.

roadmap.title:
Every great adventure
starts with a solid foundation.
roadmap.intro: This is how PokePrisma will grow. Each stage will be built and tested before moving on.
roadmap.desc1: The visual foundation you're exploring: cards, navigation and two languages.
roadmap.desc2: Explore every imported species, its variants and card sets.
roadmap.desc3: Simplified rules, teams of six and a tutorial against the computer.
roadmap.desc4: Accounts, progress, packs and private battles with friends.

preview.title:
Little cards.
Extraordinary stories.
preview.description: A selection of illustrations to try the holographic finish. Find every species in the catalogue.
preview.selection: Select a card to discover its source.
preview.motion: Reflections respect your reduced motion preference. On mobile, cards keep a static finish.
preview.noImageDetails: This example shows how a card looks when its image is unavailable.
preview.officialDetails: Reference image and data from TCGdex. The rarity and types shown belong to the printed card.

footer.note: Fan project in development. Not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company.

notFound.label: ROUTE NOT FOUND
notFound.title: This path isn't on the map yet.
notFound.description: Head back home and keep exploring PokePrisma.

catalog.title:
A universe,
one card at a time.
catalog.description: Find your favourite Pokémon, discover its artwork and explore every generation. Every species is the beginning of a collection.
catalog.search: Search Pokémon by name or number
catalog.emptyBody: Try another name or adjust the filters to keep exploring.
catalog.notice: Reference catalogue. These cards aren't part of an inventory yet. Expansion names are preserved as supplied by TCGdex in English.
catalog.errorBody: Check your connection and try again. Your progress is not changed.
catalog.unknownSpecies: This species isn't in the catalogue.
catalog.detailIntro: One species, many stories. Select a card for a closer look and discover its source.
catalog.formsNote: Original PokéAPI identifiers. Links between cards and specific forms have not yet been validated for battles.
catalog.ambiguous: This card includes multiple species or an incomplete mapping. It is shown for reference; its assignment for battles is pending.
catalog.cardNotice: Printed types, rarities and text belong to the TCG. PokePrisma battle rules and stats will be developed in a later phase.

team.title:
Six cards.
Your strategy.
team.intro: Explore artwork, combine your favourite Pokémon and choose your lead. Each species takes a single slot.
team.localNotice: Test team: choose cards from the catalog. These are not owned cards or saved to an account; battles are not available yet.
team.memory: Not saved: changes will be lost when you leave or reload.
team.addSlot: Choose a Pokémon for your team, slot {{slot}}
team.completeHint: Six distinct species. You can keep changing artwork and team order.
team.remaining_one: {{count}} more Pokémon to complete your team.
team.remaining_other: {{count}} more Pokémon to complete your team.
team.pickerHint: Find a species and choose the card that represents it. A new illustration replaces the previous one.
team.search: Search by name or Pokédex number
team.variantHint: Choose an illustration. Printed values belong to the TCG; PokePrisma stats will be defined later.
team.filterVariants: Filter by set, rarity or card ID
team.loadError: Your team could not be restored
team.retained: Your saved draft is preserved. Check your connection and try again.
team.invalidHint: The local data is invalid or a card no longer matches the catalog. You can discard it and start an empty team.

notice.replaced: Artwork replaced in the same slot.
notice.unchanged: This card is already in your team.
notice.full: You already have six Pokémon. Remove one before adding another species.
notice.ineligible: This card has no single confirmed species.
notice.promoted: Pokémon moved to the lead slot.
notice.conflict: The team changed in another tab. The latest version has been loaded; please repeat your change.
